CREDITS: Lorsieab2 proposed making the full competition suite available in
VV1, VV2, VV3, VV4 and VV5, rewriting each to reflect its setting, and
specifically proposed VV5 Heathen/Isolan competitors and judges with political
tensions. The original VV2 Cooking Contest's premise, mechanics and text are
by Lorsieab2. The game-specific adaptations, fresh dialogue, branching,
political plots and integration notes below are written by ChatGPT.
Existing universal competitions and their previous credits remain intact.

contest.text:
The Tribal Chief presides ceremonially over the Secret City's festival.
Two cooks prepare a ceremonial meal. A celebrated critic from the city's older traditions declares that a bowl of soup "has the courage of a wet leaf and the flavor to match." The Chief insists the judging be fair.

text_only.reason: an adjective for the critic; nobody celebrates

contest.name: The Chief's Table

a1.text: The critic praises an outsider's unfamiliar seasoning.

a2.text: The critic insults a traditional dish and must apologize after an elder explains its significance.

b1.text: The critic unknowingly favors the rival tradition.

b2.text: Both meals are excellent and the Chief orders a shared feast.

c1.text: An inventive method improves food preparation.

text_only.reason: a better method, not a food gain; the reward is tech

c2.text: An appalling fermented dish empties the plaza; the Chief declares a temporary ban on uncovered cooking pots.

text_only.reason: C1's reward, on the same source line

common_d.text: Allow a mixed panel of elders, practitioners and ordinary villagers to judge.
